none.name: No background
none.desc: Nothing special. Used for generated residents and monsters.

thawed.name: The Thawed
thawed.desc: You were found frozen in the shelf ice and revived. You remember a world that ended centuries ago and nobody you knew is alive.

canal_urchin.name: Canal Urchin
canal_urchin.desc: Raised on the towpaths of an Old Shires mill town, living off what fell off barges.

foundry_hand.name: Foundry Hand
foundry_hand.desc: Ten years on a Furnace Coast foundry floor. You know heat, iron and a union song.

shrine_foundling.name: Shrine Foundling
shrine_foundling.desc: Left on a shrine step as a baby and raised by its keepers.

collegium_dropout.name: Collegium Dropout
collegium_dropout.desc: Two years at a wizards' college before the money or the patience ran out.

prospector.name: Prospector
prospector.desc: You followed the retreating ice north with a pick and a claim map.

freeholder.name: Freeholder Child
freeholder.desc: Born on a Meltlands homestead that your family fought land agents to keep.

company_clerk.name: Company Clerk
company_clerk.desc: You kept the books for a Combine trading house and saw where the money really goes.

deserter.name: Deserter
deserter.desc: You walked away from one side of the war. Nobody asks which, if you're wise.

barrow_digger.name: Barrow Digger
barrow_digger.desc: You dug Firstfolk barrows for collectors, and learned which doors not to open.

riverboat_hand.name: Riverboat Hand
riverboat_hand.desc: You worked the meltwater rivers on paddle steamers and poled barges.

patent_thief.name: Patent Thief
patent_thief.desc: You copied other people's schematics for a living until a gnome lawyer caught up with you.
